Review the current 2025 BMW M5 driving lab and propose one focused, evidence-based improvement. Preserve AGENTS.md, PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md, and M5_VALIDATION.md as hard constraints. Do not tune around a sign, symmetry, braking, driveline, suspension, tire, or stability defect. Prefer a small change with deterministic regression coverage, and include npm run test:m5-validation:strict when the change can affect overall M5 behavior.
